This '''assault''' was led by a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]]s and a band of [[Sekct]] on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|hyperbaride synthesis plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. One of the [[Hyperbaride synthesis plant|plant's]] security chiefs, [[Marci Sertim]], overloaded the plant's [[Hyperbattery|hyperbatteries]] and set it on self-destruct, but not before the plant's [[Managing Director|managing director]], [[Vost Tyne]], escaped.<ref name="PotM" />
